'''Mack''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], who during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] worked for the [[Galactic Republic]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. When his men refused to complete their job of scanning key structural points in the [[Sinking City]], he offered their pay to the Republic individual who completed it.<ref name="TOR" />
